Exact target sd:mu:phylo_interaction(1 | plant:pollinator). A profile-likelihood interval for the bipartite plant:pollinator phylogenetic-interaction random-intercept SD on nbinom2 mu (log link) exists and is well-formed under ML on arc3_phylo_interaction_nbinom2_fixture (8-tip star plant tree x 8-tip star pollinator tree = 64 pairs, tip covariance = identity on each side; n_each = 24 observations per pair = 1536 obs; true interaction SD 0.6). n_each was raised from 8 to 24 after a Curie diagnostic session found a confirmed NB2 dispersion/interaction-SD confound at n_each = 8 (cor(sigma_hat, sd_hat) = -0.74 across the 2026080401-05 seed family; no count sparsity, zero-pair rate 0.000): seed 2026080405 combined a below-median sigma_hat with the family's highest sd_hat, giving a profile interval [0.610, 0.902] that excluded the true 0.6. Fisher's tightened five-seed gate (seed family 2026080401-2026080405, the same shared family used for both the local n_each = 24 point-fit gate and this promotion campaign): estimates 0.674/0.537/0.566/0.639/0.681, relative error 0.123/0.106/0.056/0.064/0.134 (mean 0.097), every value <0.35; all five 95% profile intervals bracket the true 0.6 ([0.564,0.819], [0.449,0.653], [0.472,0.690], [0.535,0.776], [0.572,0.824]), convergence 0, pdHess TRUE, profile_boundary FALSE, conf_status "profile" throughout. The retained Poisson STOP at this exact target and star-tree/64-pair geometry (mc-0438, nonfinite profile endpoints at both npair64-each8 and npair64-each20) does NOT generalise to NB2 mu at n_each = 24 either. Interval-existence claim only - no coverage, calibration, REML, other-provider, other-n_each, or public guidance claim.

Slope-only structured mu terms, e.g. "spatial(0+x|site, coords=coords)", fail the generic count_supported_term gate ("intercept-only or one-slope"). Representative row: the identical rejection applies to phylo/animal/relmat/phylo_interaction slope-only forms -- NB2 never sets allow_slope_only_structured_mu=TRUE (contrast the Poisson-spatial carve-out at R/drmTMB.R:5301-5302).

Labelled structured mu, e.g. "phylo(1|p|species, tree=tree)" matched against a parallel labelled sigma term (the Gaussian-style mean-scale phylo/spatial/animal/relmat correlation route), is rejected: the NB2 validate_count_structured_mu_term call never sets allow_labelled_scalar_structured_mu=TRUE (contrast Poisson-spatial, R/drmTMB.R:5297-5298). No NB2 test exercises this path.

Combining a structured mu term with an ordinary mu bar term, e.g. "phylo(1|species,tree=tree) + (1|id)", errors "cannot be combined with ordinary mu random effects in this first gate". Representative row for all q1-intercept providers.

Exact target sd:mu:spatial(1 | site). A profile-likelihood interval for the spatial random-intercept SD on nbinom2 mu (log link) exists and is well-formed under ML on arc4_nbinom2_mu_spatial_relmat_fixture (20-site coordinate-arc GMRF, kappa = 66.2, crossed with a 24-individual AR(1)-relatedness GMRF, kappa = 3.5; 5 observations per (site, id) cell = 2400 obs; true spatial SD 0.6 PRIMARY, simultaneous with an independent true relmat SD 0.5 COMPANION). mc-0417 is an AGGREGATE cell ("exactly two intercept-only providers drawn from {phylo, spatial, animal, relmat} ... may co-occur as primary+secondary q1 fields", C(4,2) = 6 possible pairs); this promotion BINDS the cell to the ONE pair with recovery evidence on record -- spatial+relmat -- and does NOT cover the other five provider pairs (phylo+spatial, phylo+animal, phylo+relmat, spatial+animal, animal+relmat), which remain unevaluated. Fisher's tightened five-seed gate (seed family 2026080501-2026080505, the SAME shared family used for both the local point-fit gate and this promotion campaign): estimates 0.541/0.718/0.607/0.762/0.688, relative error 0.099/0.197/0.012/0.270/0.147 (mean 0.145), every value <0.35; all five 95% profile intervals bracket the true 0.6 ([0.398,0.777], [0.524,1.037], [0.439,0.884], [0.562,1.094], [0.500,0.999]), convergence 0, pdHess TRUE, profile_boundary FALSE, conf_status "profile" throughout. The companion relmat(1 | id) SD is surfaced but NOT part of this claim: at n_id = 24, one seed's recovered relmat SD (0.713 at seed 2026080503 against true 0.5) reflects genuine finite-sample AR(1) draw variance (the realized empirical draw SD is 0.714, almost exactly recovered) diagnosed in tools/arc4-multiprovider-mu-fixtures.R rather than an estimation defect, but it is not gated here. Interval-existence claim only - no coverage, calibration, REML, other-pair, other-geometry, or public guidance claim.

Exact target sd:sigma:phylo(1 | species). A profile-likelihood interval for the phylogenetic random-intercept SD on the nbinom2 log(sigma) exists and is well-formed under ML on arc3_nbinom2_sigma_phylo_fixture (80 tips x 30 obs = 2400, true intercept SD 0.55, zero-count-cluster rate 0.000). The tree uses Grafen branch lengths rather than a coalescent: ape::rcoal() topologies are intrinsically ill-conditioned for this target (correlation-matrix condition number 98563; a 61-seed scan found 33000-540000 for every alternative and larger n_tip made it worse), which caused a flat-likelihood boundary failure on one seed. Grafen brings the condition number to 183. NB2's structured-sigma gate requires an unlabelled intercept-plus-one-slope term, so a distinct nuisance slope SD is present and is NOT part of this claim. Point-fit recovery was gated BEFORE profiling: mean relative error 0.137 over five seeds against a predeclared 0.35 gate. Interval-existence claim only - no coverage, calibration, slope-SD, REML, other-provider, or public guidance claim.

Exact target sd:sigma:spatial(1 | site). A profile-likelihood interval for the spatial random-intercept SD on the nbinom2 log(sigma) exists and is well-formed under ML on arc3_nbinom2_sigma_spatial_fixture, a purpose-built provider-specific DGP (9x9 coordinate grid, 81 sites x 25 obs = 2025, true intercept SD 0.55, zero-count-cluster rate 0.000). NB2's structured-sigma gate requires an unlabelled intercept-plus-one-slope term, so a distinct nuisance slope SD is present and is NOT part of this claim; finite-sample covariance between that slope and the profiled intercept is the documented failure mode for this fixture family (it is what sank mc-0424's first cohort), not a footnote. A spiral site layout was rejected during design because it collapsed the intercept SD; the 9x9 grid is load-bearing. Point-fit recovery was gated BEFORE profiling: mean relative error 0.296 over three seeds against a predeclared 0.35 gate. Interval-existence claim only - no coverage, calibration, slope-SD, REML, other-provider, or public guidance claim.

Interval feasibility WITHHELD by Fisher target-level review 2026-08-02. Three Totoro receipts reconciled 3/3 on the mechanical contract, but seed 2026080302 returned estimate 0.283 against a true SD of 0.55 (49% relative error) with a 95% profile interval [0.137, 0.479] that EXCLUDES the true value. The predeclared point-fit gate had been computed on a DIFFERENT seed family (423/523/623) than the promotion campaign (2026080301-03), so the fragile seed was never gated. Unlike mc-0424, no finite-sample intercept/slope correlation diagnostic has been run for the animal provider, so the mechanism is undiagnosed. Remains point_fit_recovery until that diagnostic runs and the gate is recomputed on the promotion seed family. A mechanically passing reconciliation is not sufficient when a member interval misses the truth.

Exact target sd:sigma:relmat(1 | id). A profile-likelihood interval for the supplied-relatedness random-intercept SD on the nbinom2 log(sigma) exists and is well-formed under ML on arc3_nbinom2_sigma_relmat_fixture (80-individual AR1-Toeplitz relatedness x 25 obs = 2000, true intercept SD 0.55, zero-count-cluster rate 0.000). K is well conditioned (cond 3.5); the earlier one-seed failure was NOT an information problem but finite-sample correlation between the independently drawn intercept and slope structured effects (max |cor| 0.457 at n_id=40), which produced an alternate local optimum mid-profile-sweep. Raising n_id to 80 reduces that to 0.135. NB2's structured-sigma gate requires an unlabelled intercept-plus-one-slope term, so a distinct nuisance slope SD is present and is NOT part of this claim. Point-fit recovery was gated BEFORE profiling: mean relative error 0.251 over five seeds against a predeclared 0.35 gate. Interval-existence claim only - no coverage, calibration, slope-SD, REML, other-provider, or public guidance claim.
